duplicateEdgeExceptions.reason: RECORD-00374 asserts both 'Scripps-Howard Owns Ventura Country Star' (RECORD-00374_REL_013) and 'Ventura Country Star Owned By Scripps-Howard' (RECORD-00374_REL_014) -- the same ownership fact encoded twice under Owns and its unconfirmed candidate inverse Owned By. Which row (if either) to correct or remove is a pending curator decision (issue #737).

Records assert 'Jay Rosen Owns PressThink' against the PressThink entity O0033 (RECORD-00501_REL_003, RECORD-00835_REL_025, RECORD-00800_REL_002, RECORD-00847_REL_023) and separately 'PressThink Owned By Jay Rosen' against the same entity (RECORD-00483_REL_002, RECORD-00716_REL_003) -- the same ownership fact encoded twice under Owns and its unconfirmed candidate inverse Owned By. Which label to keep is a pending curator decision (issue #737). PressThink's duplicate Work-typed entity W0666 was merged into O0033 on 2026-08-27 (issue #859), which is why this entry now covers relationship rows that used to be split across two exceptions, one per entity id.
